title: 7 things every man needs to *stop* doing now

head: Explaining yourself to people who already decided
sub: Say it once. Let your actions argue for you.

head: Double texting people who leave you on read
sub: Match their energy. Spend yours on people who reply.

head: Making your problems everyone else's problem
sub: Vent to one person you trust. Then make a plan.

head: Comparing your chapter 1 to his chapter 20
sub: Compare yourself to who you were last year. Only him.

head: Fixing every bad mood with your phone
sub: Walk it off. 10 minutes outside does more than 2 hours of scrolling.

head: Announcing goals you haven't started
sub: Work in silence for 90 days. Let the results announce it.

head: Saying "I'm tired" when you're actually bored
sub: Bored needs a challenge, not a nap. Pick something hard.

head: Pick one this week. *Not all seven.*
sub: One habit gone for good beats seven quit for a day.
